name: Workflows
description:
Overview of the two SlideRule MCP workflows:
1. Use SlideRule tools to dynamically generate datasets;
2. Read documentation resources to learn the Python client and generate code.
Recommended starting point for LLMs using the SlideRule MCP server.

name: Datasets
description: Maps scientific questions to SlideRule datasets and tools. Explains when to use ATL03, ATL06, ATL08, ATL13, ATL24, GEDI products, and other supported datasets.

name: SlideRule bundled specification
description: Self-contained OpenAPI specification for all SlideRule endpoints. Recommended for LLMs and code generation.

name: SlideRule multi-file specification
description: Multi-file OpenAPI specification for all SlideRule endpoints. Contains relative references that can be resolved through additional resource reads.

name: Installation
description: Instructions on how to install the SlideRule Python client

name: Getting Started
description: Beginner's guide to using the SlideRule Python client; initializing the client and making your first request

name: SlideRule Overview
description: Broad overview of the SlideRule data processing system and Python client

name: Basic Usage Guide
description: A guide for using the SlideRule Python client for making basic processing requests

name: X-Series Guide
description: A description of the request and response behavior of the x-series APIs

name: Raster Sampling Guide
description: A guide for how to include samples from raster datasets when generating your own custom datasets

name: ICESat-2 Guide
description: An overview of SlideRule's support for processing ICESat-2 data, with API descriptions and explanations of input parameters and output results.

name: GEDI Guide
description: An overview of SlideRule's support for processing GEDI data, with API descriptions and explanations of input parameters and output results.

name: SlideRule API Reference
description: Reference documentation for all of the base `sliderule` module Python client APIs

name: H5 API Reference
description: Reference documentation for the `h5` module Python client APIs

name: Ancillary Fields
description: An example for older p-series endpoints that walks through the steps necessary to include ancillary fields in the data returned for atl03sp and atl06p requests.

name: ArcticDEM Mosaic Sampling
description: A tutoral that walks through the steps necessary to sample the ArcticDEM at the location of each elevation generated by an atl06p request. The DEM value is returned as an additional column in the GeoDataFrame.

name: ArcticDEM Strips Sampling
description: An example for how to work with individual strips when sampling ArcticDEM at `atl06p` points.

name: ATL06 GLIMS Shapefile Usage
description: An example for using SlideRule to retrieve ATL06 segments that intersect a provided shapefile.

name: ATL09 Sampling
description: An example for how to append ATL09 data to custom generated datasets.

name: ATL09 DataFrame
description: An example for how to build a custom ATL09 DataFrame using the `h5x` API

name: ATL13 Access
description: An example for accessing ATL13 data using lake names, reference ids, and contained coordinates

name: ATL24 Access
description: An example for subsetting and filtering ATL24 data

name: ATL24 LAZ Output
description: An example for how to create a LAZ file from a subsetted and filtered ATL24 dataset

name: Surface Blanket
description: An example for running the Surface Blanket (ALS) Algorithm in ATL03x

name: Basic ATL03 Processing
description: An example that walks through using `atl03x` to get ICESat-2 data over the Boulder Watershed

name: Earthdata Query
description: An example for using different methods for querying CMR, CMR-STAC, and TNM

name: First Request
description: A tutoral for beginners that walks through the steps necessary to make your very first SlideRule processing request.

name: GEDI L2A Access
description: An example for how to access GEDI L2A data

name: GeoParquet Output
description: An example of the steps necessary to return data in the GeoParquet format when using the older p-series APIs

name: Grand Mesa
description: An example for processing ATL03 data from the Grand Mesa, CO region and produce a customized ATL06 dataset

name: ATL03 Classifications
description: An example for generating ATL03 photon classifications using ATL08 and YAPC

name: PhoREAL
description: An example for using the PhoREAL algorithm on ATL03 data to generate custom vegetation and canopy metrics
